description:
Manage linked WhatsApp accounts.
- `list` — accounts with status (`connected`, `reconnecting`, `needs_link`, `replaced`, `client_outdated`, `error`) and archive size.
- `add` — link a NEW account, or RE-LINK an existing one: call `add` with the SAME `account_id`. Re-linking keeps the whole message archive. Use it when status is `needs_link` or the device was removed on the phone (new link: without `phone` a local QR page, with `phone` an 8-character pairing code), or when status is `replaced`/`error` (reconnects with the existing keys, no QR).
- `remove` — FORGET the account: unlinks the device AND PERMANENTLY DELETES this account's message archive from this computer. Downloaded files are kept. To reconnect a broken account, do NOT use remove; use `add` with the same `account_id`.

account_id.description: account nickname: lowercase latin letters, digits, _ and -, up to 64; required for add and remove

phone.description: add only: phone number of the account in international format; returns a pairing code instead of a QR page

name: manage-accounts
